title: Viewpoints: merging and separation
shows: Combining the functional and timing viewpoints of one component, checking an implementation against them, and removing a viewpoint with separation.

steps.note: Both viewpoints describe the same component, so they are merged, not composed.
Granting exactly one step after each request satisfies both viewpoints.
Always granting satisfies the functional viewpoint but not the timing one: the trace grants one step after a step with no request.
The smallest contract that, merged with Timing, gives back a contract refined by Arbiter.
